# John Serra

John Serra is a data-driven problem solver whose work spans manufacturing, education, urban mobility, business development, and process automation. CareerTalkLab's existing product is an English-learning LMS; he is preparing the Grain First public learning series, with broader data and software career-learning integration planned.
